options.opa: The fraction or percentage of drug dose that after being administered in a certain pharmaceutical form has unchanged access to the biophase compared to an intravenous preparation thereof.
options.opb: The fraction or percentage of drug dose that after being administered in a certain pharmaceutical form has unaltered access to the systemic circulation compared to a standard preparation thereof.
options.opc: The fraction or percentage of drug dose that after being administered in a certain pharmaceutical form has unaltered access to the systemic circulation compared to an intravenous preparation thereof.
options.opd: That 100% of the dose of drug administered in a certain pharmaceutical form has unaltered access to the general circulation.
options.ope: The fraction or percentage of drug dose that after being administered in a certain pharmaceutical form has unaltered access to the place of absorption in comparison with a standard preparation thereof.
